dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if my arms and legs feel sore, and I'm dizzy with a stiff neck...?

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: No obvious external injuries, then? And no symptoms like fever?

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: The equipment I have here is limited. I mainly handle external injuries and common colds, so I would suggest visiting a proper medical facility for a more thorough examination.

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: What you described could also be the result of overexertion, or poor sitting posture.

dialogues.speaker: Oktyabrskaya
dialogues.text: Excessive stress and bad habits can both lead to physical discomfort... Please be careful and take this seriously.
